name: display
note: Linux, run with CV_WAYLAND=1 on the run's own headless Weston (1280x720; an X display of the tests' has no window manager to make a window fullscreen): the display modes changed live as the settings menu changes them, by the window's size the game draws into (telemetry window_size): borderless and fullscreen fill the display, windowed is back to 960x540. On Windows they would take the PC's own screen.
